All selected methods enforce deadline. Exact-input swaps enforce output minimum; exact-output swaps enforce input maximum (or msg.value) and native excess is refunded to msg.sender. Price calculations read each pair's swapFee in basis points; output floors division and required exact-output input rounds up. No fixed fee or price is promised.

Adds choose reserve-proportional amounts, transfer caller tokens into a deterministically derived own-factory pair and mint LP to to; new pairs may be created. In an empty pair the desired amounts are used without a separate minimum check. Burns transfer caller LP then enforce reserve-output minima, and native variants unwrap the wrapped-native leg. LP mint/burn rounding, pool fee accounting and market state belong to the pair.

Fee-on-transfer swap variants measure actual received inputs and recipient token balance delta, except token-to-native uses the router's entire wrapped-native balance. The fee-on-transfer native liquidity-removal variant forwards the router's entire token balance; token minimum is checked against pair pre-tax output, not necessarily final recipient receipt. Avoid relying on router dust ownership or universal fee-token support.

Honeyswap mutable pair fees, liquidity, token behavior, recipient receive behavior and MEV can change execution results; no market capacity or live liquidity prerequisite is imposed or guaranteed. Permit-combined withdrawals are excluded even though plain withdrawal counterparts are selected.
